author: JKawesome
body:
I started on this map with X_Heat a few months ago, but then we kinda lost interest in it, and put the project on hold for a while. For the past few days I was stuck at home without wifi access, so I decided to just finish this in single player. Hope you guys like it c:

There also will be a TNT feature, but I won't say what it is, so you can figure it out in-game.

Thanks to iBiZa_MiNeCrAfT for the name suggestion in a previous thread!



- Full album
- Download

I do need a mapdev to help me with the YML, since I have no idea how to do one for CTW, as it's not in the YML Docs. If you could help me, please let me know c:

replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
Welp. I'll guess Ill make feedback. 

  • If TNT is going to be a main aspect for this map it will need serious working. There are quick cannons that can/will shoot into the spawn of the team. A basic spread or barf cannon will literally obliterate the map in seconds.
  • Tunneling looks a bit too easy. You can tunnel under the wool room add a bedrock wall perpendicular to the ground so defenders have to surface at some point
  • Also defenders can literally create a cannon pointing at the wool room and obliterate anyone that can make it in.
  • I think this map is just too small for a CTW TNT and these maps don't work that well unless gone through dozens of revisions
  • Team grief rules would be put under disrepute as a defender can use TNT for defense making to blow out a pit so there will be grey areas in this rules.
  • Spawn blocking from Icaruses is also a possibility
  • Overall I don't think this map is suited for TNT
